items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: You see the Scott Joplin books, all those rags... I used to play all those tunes

ctx.x: But those bands, I mean Imperial and I just can't, I just can't recall these people, they're playing music, but these fellas, I mean, oh man, they played. You see the Scott Joplin books, all those rags, you don't hear none of that music. And them guys just took that music and played that music and didn't have the jazz, just play it. Just play it, man. So beautiful, man. All those, Maple Leaf Rag, Grayson Buta, African Pass, Ophelia Rag, Entertainer's Rag. Oh man, oh, I used to play all those tunes, you know. Of…
Did you ever hear of Chris Kelly's one?
